beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The Unidirectional Transformer Trap unlocks 80.5% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A linear stream of tokens being blocked by an opaque wall.

visual_blueprint.title: THE UNIDIRECTIONAL WALL
visual_blueprint.sub: Predicting the next token without looking ahead

motif_params.title: THE UNIDIRECTIONAL WALL
motif_params.sub: Predicting the next token without looking ahead

beats.text: This autoregressive bottleneck forces the model to guess the future, trapping intelligence inside a one-way street of rigid, shallow projections.
beats.visual_focus: A bottleneck funnel narrowing flow to a singular, desperate path.

visual_blueprint.title: AUTOREGRESSIVE BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Information loss via forced serial dependency

motif_params.title: AUTOREGRESSIVE BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Information loss via forced serial dependency

beats.text: BERT shatters this barrier by using masked language modeling to let every token peer into both left and right neighbors simultaneously.
beats.visual_focus: Tokens refracting into a bidirectional attention matrix.

visual_blueprint.title: THE UNIDIRECTIONAL ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: Tokens refracting into a bidirectional attention matrix.

beats.text: By replacing the standard mask with random hidden token objectives, the encoder learns a truly deep, context-rich representation for every single word.
beats.visual_focus: A dense layer stack pulsating as it reconstructs masked inputs.
